title: Emergency shelter for Lānaʻi
summary: At an April 15, 2026 meeting, another testifier asked for a community center that could also serve as an emergency shelter. A council member said the military is looking at county land for a category five shelter, like a bunker, and that a new affordable housing project includes a community center open to everyone. A lifetime Lānaʻi resident made a similar call in April 2025.
